gdp_level.label: GDP, current market prices, not seasonally adjusted (C&SD, table 310-31001)

gdp_real.label: Real GDP, chained (2024) dollars, not seasonally adjusted (C&SD, table 310-31001)

gdp_growth.label: Real GDP growth, change on previous quarter, seasonally adjusted (C&SD, table 310-31001)

gdp_growth_yoy.label: Real GDP growth, change on same quarter a year earlier (C&SD, table 310-31001)

cpi.label: Composite CPI, all items, change on same month a year earlier (IMF CPI, from C&SD)

cpi_mom.label: Composite CPI, all items, change on previous month, not seasonally adjusted (IMF CPI)

policy_rate.label: HKMA base rate (BIS central bank policy rates, M.HK, from October 1998)

exports.label: Exports of goods, including re-exports, FOB, US$ converted to HK$ at the BIS monthly average rate (IMF international trade in goods)

imports.label: Imports of goods, CIF, US$ converted to HK$ at the BIS monthly average rate (IMF international trade in goods)

trade_balance.label: Trade balance, goods, exports less imports, HK$ (IMF ITG, converted at the BIS monthly average rate)

unemployment.label: Unemployment rate, ILO modelled estimate, annual (World Bank)

debt_gdp.label: General government gross debt, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

deficit.label: General government net lending/borrowing, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

current_account.label: Current account balance, % of GDP (World Bank)

fdi.label: FDI net inflows, % of GDP (World Bank)
